The '''Odoon clan''' was one of the seven major clans of [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]]. It was named for the ''[[Odoon]]'', one of the original [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]] which brought [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to Ammuud.
